title: Eye-BCI multimodal MI/ME dataset from Guttmann-Flury et al 2025
description: A multimodal EEG dataset of motor imagery (MI) recorded from 31 healthy participants over up to three sessions each. Participants imagined left- and right-hand grasping in response to visual cues while 64-channel EEG plus EOG were recorded at 1000 Hz. This is a MOABB-derived version of the Eye-BCI dataset, which also includes eye-tracking and high-speed video for ocular activity analysis across BCI paradigms.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Neuroscan Quik-Cap (65 channels) and SynAmps2 amplifier at 1000 Hz, referenced to the right mastoid with a forehead ground. Each session comprised 40 two-class hand grasping motor imagery trials, cued by a visual rectangle, with a 4 s imagery period and no feedback.
